IsSidon_fc: def IsSidon (A : Set α) : Prop := ∀ᵉ (i₁ ∈ A) (j₁ ∈ A) (i₂ ∈ A) (j₂ ∈ A), i₁ + i₂ = j₁ + j₂ → (i₁ = j₁ ∧ i₂ = j₂) ∨ (i₁ = j₂ ∧ i₂ = j₁)
IsSidon_ours: def IsSidon (A : Set α) : Prop := ∀ᵉ (i₁ ∈ A) (j₁ ∈ A) (i₂ ∈ A) (j₂ ∈ A), i₁ + i₂ = j₁ + j₂ → (i₁ = j₁ ∧ i₂ = j₂) ∨ (i₁ = j₂ ∧ i₂ = j₁)
maxSidonSubsetCard_fc: def maxSidonSubsetCard (A : Finset α) [DecidableEq α] : ℕ := (A.powerset.filter fun B : Finset α ↦ IsSidon (B : Set α)).sup Finset.card
maxSidonSubsetCard_ours: def maxSidonSubsetCard (A : Finset α) [DecidableEq α] : ℕ := (A.powerset.filter fun B : Finset α ↦ IsSidon (B : Set α)).sup Finset.card
h_fc: noncomputable abbrev h (N : ℕ) : ℕ := Finset.maxSidonSubsetCard (Finset.Icc 1 N)
h_ours: noncomputable abbrev h (N : ℕ) : ℕ := maxSidonSubsetCard (Finset.Icc 1 N)
